scope: Exploratory reanalysis of already observed cycle10 candidates, not a fresh evaluation
candidate_set: All fixed20 groups of4 cycle10 candidates, no regeneration or selection of seeds
hypothesis: Constrain selection to preserve at least the control's distinct-pitch count and at most its repeated-pitch fraction, then minimize above-octave leaps; expect less leap reduction but less collapse in these two diversity proxies.
unconstrained: cycle10 minimum leap fraction, earliest tie
constrained: filter relative to same-group control on both diversity proxies, then minimum leap fraction, earliest tie
fallback: Control is always eligible; report groups with no alternative eligible candidate. No synthetic repair.
cost: Reuse4 candidates pergroup; constraints add selection work, not another training run
